name: The fragile floor: she leads and breaks it, you go round
body: The bouncy squares are gone. A row of slabs crosses a chasm; she walks it first and the slabs she crosses crumble for good. You take the stepping stones round.

comments.text: Filed 2026-11-16 before any code, from Dean's play-test of the prototype rooms and the crossing (#107, #108).

acceptance_criteria: No bounce pads in the room
The slabs never return once broken
The stepping stones are a jumpable path
